svg.text: A retained tail still needs a complete leak route
31 October 2026 / RWT-METALS / conditional geometry and maintenance comparison / not for construction
A Located northward alternative: the short tail does not shorten the secondary route
Court band
Opened family-room territory
Garden band
W1: retained tail to separately released room carrier
Separate leak collector: geometry, joints and supports unknown
From room face y8167.5 to exterior face y12000: another 3832.5 mm of plan route.
Plan bands are located; vertical separation/fall is schematic. No visible terminal or working assembly is drawn.
B A return to the court must descend from the controlling low point
Retained W1 fall across the court band: 417.5 x 60 / 4250 = 5.894 mm.
z0: W1 outside bottom at court face. a: separation to collector flow line at room-side low point.
f: total further fall to the courtward outlet. Both a and f are nonnegative and unselected.
Necessary bound: z_out <= z0 - 5.894 - a - f
An outlet lip at or above z0 fails this no-ponding return screen. A lower lip is not a flow/backwater pass.
No pan level, historic receiver target, hydraulic head or pump is substituted into this comparison.
C A collector and flange share an envelope, not automatically usable space
k = complete collector projection below the 108 tube. Lower extent at a 220 joint = max(110,54+k).

The 56 mm below the bare tube is occupied by the flange. Superposition is not an interference or access check.
50 cover / 220 flange / 60 fall. k is local; 0,56,76 are probes, not one installed collector profile.
A real joint must be accessible beyond the room face. No flange is assumed all along the tail; all other floor duties remain.
Source, generated values and maintenance limits: retained-tail-leak-route.md / .json / .mjs. W1, court W2 and ground barrier remain distinct.
